## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Deep Infra) · $0.23/M blended · $0.13 in / $0.53 out per 1M tokens · [deepinfra.com](https://deepinfra.com/models)

<sub>[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/deepinfra/models/tencent/Hy3.toml): Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/tencent/hy3.toml)</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Hunyuan Hy3 (295B-A21B) (Q4_K_M, needs 185 GB memory, 182.2 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Hy3-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/Hy3-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/Hy3-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: IQ2_M (105 GB memory, 102.1 GB download) `llama cli -hf bartowski/Hy3-GGUF:IQ2_M`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Hunyuan Hy3 (295B-A21B) (Q4_K_M, needs 185 GB memory, 182.2 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Hy3-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Hy3-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: IQ2_M (105 GB memory, 102.1 GB download) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Hy3-GGUF@IQ2_M -y`
